item.content:encoded: The stories are making me feel stupid at this point. I no longer really follow who is who, at what point in the narrative something is happening, in what act of the story we are, what the MTF's intentions were or if anything has been achieved. This is partially my fault for having a bad people memory, but I feel like I should have taken notes with all previously mentioned names since it feels like there are way more characters (and their dream identities) introduced than I can deal with in this little narrative, with only Qi Shao having enough attributes to stick in my mind.

item.content:encoded:
The interviewer is some other unnamed site psychologist.

I used Dr. Glass in general because he seemed like the best fit. In my mind he doesn't think what he's doing is strange or creepy, he's completely up front with Shao about what the process entails.

In the first tale he's referred to as Mr. Glass because they don't know his name, and Sherry just kind of gives him that nickname because all she sees is the glass.

item.content:encoded: Something I'm curious about: If their Shadows represent their qualia-selves and they can't perceive anything in the dream-state once it's been consumed/destroyed, why were they able to remember what happened from before it was consumed? Maybe I'm misinterpreting, but I thought that their "selves" were actually traveling outside of their own psyche-spaces when doing this, so there wouldn't be anything left to travel "back" with the memories/experiences.
